remarks: Your dreamy sunset, conveniently located and perfect starter and or downsizer home alike is now available. Located in the heart of Glenbrook with access to tons of nearby amenities, minimal maintenance for peace of mind, private parking spot behind the building as well as off-street parking and a doorman for the building, this home is more than well equip. Enjoy laundry and storage on the same floor, being an end-unit for added privacy and amazing city scape views, tree lines and wowing sunsets. The open floor plan ensures convenience with a spacious oversized bedroom, ample closet space and private full-bath. With views from the kitchen, living room and bedroom, a half bath for guests and entertaining, and large hallway coat closet, these are just some of many bonuses this unit provides. Easy access to bus lines, metro north, shopping and dining and i95 for commuters. HOA handles gas, heat, trash and hot water. There is audio and video recording devices both inside and outside of the home.
